NGA.note: Only an unlicensed private site selling NIN records; no state-accepted authentication service.

facts.fact: FIJ says Section 14 of the NIMC Act, 2007 allows only the National Identity Management Commission and its licensed agents to register individuals or offer NIN-related services.

NGA.note: No enrolment count or share stated.
No operation or maintenance of the ID system stated.
No public register keyed on the NIN stated.
No uniqueness, biometric check or audit of the system stated.
Only an unlicensed site selling NIN records, which NIMC does not list among its 98 licensed partners; no service in use verifying against the ID.
